The '''Brown Belt''' is an {{Epic}} [[Belts|Belt]]. This item is automatically {{DG|Soulbound}} upon receiving it. It can be upgraded into the {{Item|Black Belt}}, and is a direct upgrade from the {{Item|Blue Belt}}.

== Obtaining ==

It is obtainable from {{NPCSprite|Master Tao}} after reaching 6000 points in the {{Zone|Dojo}}. It gives {{Stat|health|+30}} and {{Stat|def|+20}}. Its ability reduces all damage taken by {{Green|5%}}.
